    The lattice of pretorsion theories #

    Theorem 3.6 of the manuscript: in an abelian category with a length function, the pretorsion theories form a complete lattice for the order (2.2). The meet of a family is (⋂ Tᵢ, ⋂ {F : (⋂ Tᵢ, F) is a pretorsion theory, F ⊇ Fᵢ}) (3.2), by Propositions 3.2 and 3.5; the join (3.3) follows by duality (Remark 2.6). The least element is (0, mod) and the greatest (mod, 0).
